svg.title: The connection cancels a false change
svg.desc: The coordinate components of a fixed eastward unit vector are followed in the angular direction. The explicit Christoffel symbol supplies the opposite change. On the flat polar plane, the radial component of the covariant derivative is zero. The derivative direction is θ, and Γ^r_{θθ} = −r. These are coordinate-basis components, not components in a unit basis.

g.text: 12 / THE CONNECTION CANCELS A FALSE CHANGE
The arrow stays fixed. Its address changes.
Differentiate in the angular direction, at fixed radius.
The indices select the term we need.
Changing components and a changing basis cancel exactly.
